name: Double Gold
description: Raspberry variety released by Cornell University's berry breeding program in 2012, described by Cornell's own announcement as well suited for small-scale growers and home gardeners, on vigorous, disease-resistant plants.

attributes.disease_resistance_note: Described by the breeder as disease resistant; no specific pathogen named in available Evidence -- not fabricated.
attributes.package_note: No public quantitative trait datasheet (firmness, Brix, shelf life) was found in the available Evidence.
